description: Teams need to reconcile two spreadsheet versions and see what changed, what conflicts, and which rows or columns need manual review.

case_sensitive.description: When false, row key matching and field comparisons ignore letter case. When true, comparisons preserve letter case exactly.

match_keys.description: Provide one or more column names used to match rows between Sheet A and Sheet B. Separate multiple keys with commas, semicolons, or new lines. Each key must exist in both sheets after normalization.

sheet_a.description: Paste or upload the first sheet snapshot as tabular text. Accept CSV-style or TSV-style rows with a header row. Must contain at least one data row and one header row.

sheet_b.description: Paste or upload the second sheet snapshot as tabular text. Accept CSV-style or TSV-style rows with a header row. Must contain at least one data row and one header row.

trim_whitespace.description: When true, leading and trailing whitespace is removed from headers, keys, and cell values before matching and comparison. Internal spaces are preserved.

name: spreadsheet-merge-conflict-reconciler
title: Spreadsheet Merge Conflict Reconciler
